<subject>Catherine Storey for Litigation Support Services</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues.  However, each of you agreed that a standard close-of-business window was acceptable for US litigation, corporate and compliance matters.

The best option will be to agree to finalise submissions by 4pm each day (just to get an idea of the volume we were discussing, I reviewed yesterday’s activity to assess how many filings were processed after 4pm London time.  We had three US litigation filings, and two Canadian corporate registrations).  After 4pm, the system would automatically roll new Litigation Support Services matters to the next day.  However, for those submissions that do not carry over after 4pm, the respective advisory teams would need to acknowledge that these items become the following day's responsibility.  I am not sure how the protocols in Apex Governance LLP would need to be adjusted for the team’s daily position summaries, as the official records would not include these late submissions.  Can Apex Governance LLP generate supplemental reports to ensure that the practice groups have accurate case statuses each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a 4pm deadline works for each of your respective teams.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the DPR?  
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?  
</body>
